Title: General availability: Metrics in Azure Traffic Manager

Body.Content:
Azure Traffic Manager provides metrics for monitoring the health status of endpoints in a profile and the amount of traffic that a profile receives. These metrics are now generally available.

You can also configure and receive alerts based on conditions that interest you. These metrics and alerts are provided via the Azure Monitor service.

The metrics that are available in Azure Traffic Manager are:

  • Queries by Endpoint Returned: The number of queries processed by Azure Traffic Manager for a profile in a specific time period.
  • Endpoint Status by Endpoint: The health status of an endpoint specified in a profile.

For more information about these metrics, including creating alerts for them, see the Azure Traffic Manager documentation.
